v.t: Alif, Lam, Ra. A Scripture that We revealed to you, that you may bring humanity from darkness to light—with the permission of their Lord—to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy
v.l: Alif-Lam-Ra Kitabun 'Anzalnahu 'Ilayka Litukhrija An-Nasa Mina Az-Zulumati 'Ila An-Nur Bi'idhni Rabbihim 'Ila Sirati Al-`Azizi Al-Hamidi
w: so that you may bring out

v.t: God—to whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe torment
v.l: Allahi Al-Ladhi Lahu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Waylun Lilkafirina Min `Adhabin Shadidin

v.t: Those who prefer the present life to the Hereafter, and repel from the path of God, and seek to make it crooked—these are far astray
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yastahibbuna Al-Hayaata Ad-Dunya `Ala Al-'Akhirati Wa Yasudduna `An Sabili Allahi Wa Yabghunaha `Iwajaan 'Ula'ika Fi Đalalin Ba`idin

v.t: We never sent any messenger except in the language of his people, to make things clear for them. God leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. He is the Mighty, the Wise
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Min Rasulin 'Illa Bilisani Qawmihi Liyubayyina Lahum Fayuđillu Allahu Man Yasha'u Wa Yahdi Man Yasha'u Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu
w: so that he might make clear

v.t: We sent Moses with Our signs: “Bring your people out of darkness into light, and remind them of the Days of God.” In that are signs for every patient and thankful person.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Musa Bi'ayatina 'An 'Akhrij Qawmaka Mina Az-Zulumati 'Ila An-Nuri Wa Dhakkirhum Bi'ayyami Allahi 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Likulli Sabbarin Shakurin

v.t: Moses said to his people, “Remember God’s blessings upon you, as He delivered you from the people of Pharaoh, who inflicted on you terrible suffering, slaughtering your sons while sparing your daughters. In that was a serious trial from your Lord.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala Musa Liqawmihi Adhkuru Ni`mata Allahi `Alaykum 'Idh 'Anjakum Min 'Ali Fir`awna Yasumunakum Su'a Al-`Adhabi Wa Yudhabbihuna 'Abna'akum Wa Yastahyuna Nisa'akum Wa Fi Dhalikum Bala'un Min Rabbikum `Azimun

v.t: And when your Lord proclaimed: “If you give thanks, I will grant you increase; but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Ta'adhana Rabbukum La'in Shakartum La'azidannakum Wa La'in Kafartum 'Inna `Adhabi Lashadidun

v.t: And Moses said, “Even if you are ungrateful, together with everyone on earth—God is in no need, Worthy of Praise.”
v.l: Wa Qala Musa 'In Takfuru 'Antum Wa Man Fi Al-'Arđi Jami`aan Fa'inna Allaha Laghaniyun Hamidun

v.t: Has not the story reached you, of those before you, the people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood—and those after them? None knows them except God. Their messengers came to them with the clear proofs, but they tried to silence them, and said, “We reject what you are sent with, and we are in serious doubt regarding what you are calling us to.”
v.l: Alam Ya'tikum Naba'u Al-Ladhina Min Qablikum Qawmi Nuhin Wa `Adin Wa Thamuda Wa Al-Ladhina Min Ba`dihim La Ya`lamuhum 'Illa Allahu Ja'at/hum Rusuluhum Bil-Bayyinati Faraddu 'Aydiyahum Fi 'Afwahihim Wa Qalu 'Inna Kafarna Bima 'Ursiltum Bihi Wa 'Inna Lafi Shakkin Mimma Tad`unana 'Ilayhi Muribin

v.t: Their messengers said, “Is there any doubt about God, Maker of the heavens and the earth? He calls you to forgive you your sins, and to defer you until a stated term.” They said, “You are only humans like us; you want to turn us away from what our ancestors worshiped; so bring us a clear proof.”
v.l: Qalat Rusuluhum 'Afi Allahi Shakkun Fatiri As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Yad`ukum Liyaghfira Lakum Min Dhunubikum Wa Yu'uakhkhirakum 'Ila 'Ajalin Musammaan Qalu 'In 'Antum 'Illa Basharun Mithluna Turiduna 'An Tasudduna `Amma Kana Ya`budu 'Aba'uuna Fa'tuna Bisultanin Mubinin

v.t: Their messengers said to them, “We are only humans like you, but God favors whomever He wills from among His servants. We cannot possibly show you any proof, except by leave of God. In God let the faithful put their trust.”
v.l: Qalat Lahum Rusuluhum 'In Nahnu 'Illa Basharun Mithlukum Wa Lakinna Allaha Yamunnu `Ala Man Yasha'u Min `Ibadihi Wa Ma Kana Lana 'An Na'tiyakum Bisultanin 'Illa Bi'idhni Allahi Wa `Ala Allahi Falyatawakkali Al-Mu'uminuna

v.t: “And why should we not trust in God, when He has guided us in our ways? We will persevere in the face of your persecution. And upon God the reliant should rely.”
v.l: Wa Ma Lana 'Alla Natawakkala `Ala Allahi Wa Qad Hadana Subulana Wa Lanasbiranna `Ala Ma 'Adhaytumuna Wa `Ala Allahi Falyatawakkali Al-Mutawakkiluna
w: And surely we will bear with patience

v.t: Those who disbelieved said to their messengers, “We will expel you from our land, unless you return to our religion.” And their Lord inspired them: “We will destroy the wrongdoers.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lirusulihim Lanukhrijannakum Min 'Arđina 'Aw Lata`udunna Fi Millatina Fa'awha 'Ilayhim Rabbuhum Lanuhlikanna Az-Zalimina
w: Surely we will drive you out

v.t: “And We will settle you in the land after them. That is for him who fears My Majesty, and fears My threats.”
v.l: Wa Lanuskinannakumu Al-'Arđa Min Ba`dihim Dhalika Liman Khafa Maqami Wa Khafa Wa`idi
w: And surely We will make you dwell

v.t: And they prayed for victory, and every stubborn tyrant came to disappointment
v.l: Wa Astaftahu Wa Khaba Kullu Jabbarin `Anidin

v.t: Beyond him lies Hell, and he will be given to drink putrid water
v.l: Min Wara'ihi Jahannamu Wa Yusqa Min Ma'in Sadidin
w: and he will be made to drink

v.t: He will guzzle it, but he will not swallow it. Death will come at him from every direction, but he will not die. And beyond this is relentless suffering
v.l: Yatajarra`uhu Wa La Yakadu Yusighuhu Wa Ya'tihi Al-Mawtu Min Kulli Makanin Wa Ma Huwa Bimayyitin Wa Min Wara'ihi `Adhabun Ghalizun

v.t: The likeness of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes, in a fierce wind, on a stormy day. They have no control over anything they have earned. That is the utmost misguidance
v.l: Mathalu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Birabbihim 'A`maluhum Karamadin Ashtaddat Bihi Ar-Rihu Fi Yawmin `Asifin La Yaqdiruna Mimma Kasabu `Ala Shay'in Dhalika Huwa Ađ-Đalalu Al-Ba`idu

v.t: Do you not see that God created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He wills, He can do away with you, and bring a new creation
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna Allaha Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Bil-Haqqi 'In Yasha' Yudh/hibkum Wa Ya'ti Bikhalqin Jadidin

v.t: And that is not difficult for God
v.l: Wa Ma Dhalika `Ala Allahi Bi`azizin

v.t: They will emerge before God, altogether. The weak will say to those who were proud, “We were your followers, can you protect us at all against God’s punishment?” They will say, “Had God guided us, we would have guided you. It is the same for us; whether we mourn, or are patient; there is no asylum for us.”
v.l: Wa Barazu Lillahi Jami`aan Faqala Ađ-Đu`afa'u Lilladhina Astakbaru 'Inna Kunna Lakum Taba`aan Fahal 'Antum Mughnuna `Anna Min `Adhabi Allahi Min Shay'in Qalu Law Hadana Allahu Lahadaynakum Sawa'un `Alayna 'Ajazi`na 'Am Sabarna Ma Lana Min Mahisin
w: surely we would have guided you

v.t: And Satan will say, when the issue is settled, “God has promised you the promise of truth, and I promised you, but I failed you. I had no authority over you, except that I called you, and you answered me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves. I cannot come to your aid, nor can you come to my aid. I reject your associating with me in the past. The wrongdoers will have a torment most painful.”
v.l: Wa Qala Ash-Shaytanu Lamma Quđiya Al-'Amru 'Inna Allaha Wa`adakum Wa`da Al-Haqqi Wa Wa`adtukum Fa'akhlaftukum Wa Ma Kana Li `Alaykum Min Sultanin 'Illa 'An Da`awtukum Fastajabtum Li Fala Talumuni Wa Lumu 'Anfusakum Ma 'Ana Bimusrikhikum Wa Ma 'Antum Bimusrikhiya 'Inni Kafartu Bima 'Ashraktumuni Min Qablu 'Inna Az-Zalimina Lahum `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: But those who believed and did good deeds will be admitted into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to remain therein forever, by leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be: “Peace.”
v.l: Wa 'Udkhila Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Jannatin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Khalidina Fiha Bi'idhni Rabbihim Tahiyatuhum Fiha Salamun

v.t: Do you not see how God presents a parable? A good word is like a good tree—its root is firm, and its branches are in the sky
v.l: Alam Tara Kayfa Đaraba Allahu Mathalaan Kalimatan Tayyibatan Kashajaratin Tayyibatin 'Asluha Thabitun Wa Far`uha Fi As-Sama'i

v.t: It yields its fruits every season by the will of its Lord. God presents the parables to the people, so that they may reflect
v.l: Tu'uti 'Ukulaha Kulla Hinin Bi'idhni Rabbiha Wa Yađribu Allahu Al-'Amthala Lilnnasi La`allahum Yatadhakkaruna

v.t: And the parable of a bad word is that of a bad tree—it is uprooted from the ground; it has no stability
v.l: Wa Mathalu Kalimatin Khabithatin Kashajaratin Khabithatin Ajtuththat Min Fawqi Al-'Arđi Ma Laha Min Qararin

v.t: God gives firmness to those who believe, with the firm word, in this life, and in the Hereafter. And God leads the wicked astray. God does whatever He wills
v.l: Yuthabbitu Allahu Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Bil-Qawli Ath-Thabiti Fi Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Fi Al-'Akhirati Wa Yuđillu Allahu Az-Zalimina Wa Yaf`alu Allahu Ma Yasha'u

v.t: Have you not seen those who exchanged the blessing of God with blasphemy, and landed their people into the house of perdition
v.l: Alam Tara 'Ila Al-Ladhina Baddalu Ni`mata Allahi Kufraan Wa 'Ahallu Qawmahum Dara Al-Bawari

v.t: Hell—they will roast in it. What a miserable settlement
v.l: Jahannama Yaslawnaha Wa Bi'sa Al-Qararu

v.t: And they set up rivals to God, in order to lead away from His path. Say, “Enjoy yourselves; your destination is the Fire.”
v.l: Wa Ja`alu Lillahi 'Andadaan Liyuđillu `An Sabilihi Qul Tamatta`u Fa'inna Masirakum 'Ila An-Nari

v.t: Tell My servants who have believed to perform the prayers, and to give from what We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there is neither trading nor friendship
v.l: Qul Li`ibadiya Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Yuqimu As-Salaata Wa Yunfiqu Mimma Razaqnahum Sirraan Wa `Alaniyatan Min Qabli 'An Ya'tiya Yawmun La Bay`un Fihi Wa La Khilalun

v.t: God is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down water from the sky, and with it produces fruits for your sustenance. And He committed the ships to your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and He committed the rivers to your service
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'akhraja Bihi Mina Ath-Thamarati Rizqaan Lakum Wa Sakhkhara Lakumu Al-Fulka Litajriya Fi Al-Bahri Bi'amrihi Wa Sakhkhara Lakumu Al-'Anhara

v.t: And He committed the sun and the moon to your service, both continuously pursuing their courses, and He committed the night and the day to your service
v.l: Wa Sakhkhara Lakumu Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Da'ibayni Wa Sakhkhara Lakumu Al-Layla Wa An-Nahar

v.t: And He has given you something of all what you asked. And if you were to count God’s blessings, you would not be able to enumerate them. The human being is unfair and ungrateful
v.l: Wa 'Atakum Min Kulli Ma Sa'altumuhu Wa 'In Ta`uddu Ni`mata Allahi La Tuhsuha 'Inna Al-'Insana Lazalumun Kaffarun
w: you will (be able to) count them

v.t: Recall that Abraham said, “O my Lord, make this land peaceful, and keep me and my sons from worshiping idols.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala 'Ibrahimu Rabbi Aj`al Hadha Al-Balada 'Aminaan Wa Ajnubni Wa Baniya 'An Na`buda Al-'Asnama

v.t: “My Lord, they have led many people astray. Whoever follows me belongs with me; and whoever disobeys me—You are Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Rabbi 'Innahunna 'Ađlalna Kathiraan Mina An-Nasi Faman Tabi`ani Fa'innahu Minni Wa Man `Asani Fa'innaka Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: “Our Lord, I have settled some of my offspring in a valley of no vegetation, by Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may perform the prayers. So make the hearts of some people incline towards them, and provide them with fruits, that they may be thankful.”
v.l: Rabbana 'Inni 'Askantu Min Dhurriyati Biwadin Ghayri Dhi Zar`in `Inda Baytika Al-Muharrami Rabbana Liyuqimu As-Salaata Faj`al 'Af'idatan Mina An-Nasi Tahwi 'Ilayhim Wa Arzuqhum Mina Ath-Thamarati La`allahum Yashkuruna

v.t: “Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we reveal. And nothing is hidden from God, on earth or in the heaven.”
v.l: Rabbana 'Innaka Ta`lamu Ma Nukhfi Wa Ma Nu`linu Wa Ma Yakhfa `Ala Allahi Min Shay'in Fi Al-'Arđi Wa La Fi As-Sama'i

v.t: “Praise be to God, Who has given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac. My Lord is the Hearer of Prayers.”
v.l: Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Wahaba Li `Ala Al-Kibari 'Isma`ila Wa 'Ishaqa 'Inna Rabbi Lasami`u Ad-Du`a'i

v.t: “My Lord, make me one who performs the prayer, and from my offspring. Our Lord, accept my supplication.”
v.l: Rabbi Aj`alni Muqima As-Salaati Wa Min Dhurriyati Rabbana Wa Taqabbal Du`a'i

v.t: “Our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers, on the Day the Reckoning takes place.”
v.l: Rabbana Aghfir Li Wa Liwalidayya Wa Lilmu'uminina Yawma Yaqumu Al-Hisabu

v.t: Do not ever think that God is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only defers them until a Day when the sights stare
v.l: Wa La Tahsabanna Allaha Ghafilaan `Amma Ya`malu Az-Zalimuna 'Innama Yu'uakhkhiruhum Liyawmin Tashkhasu Fihi Al-'Absaru

v.t: Their necks outstretched, their heads upraised, their gaze unblinking, their hearts void
v.l: Muhti`ina Muqni`i Ru'usihim La Yartaddu 'Ilayhim Tarfuhum Wa 'Af'idatuhum Hawa'un

v.t: And warn mankind of the Day when the punishment will come upon them, and the wicked will say, “Our Lord, defer us for a little while, and we will answer Your call and follow the messengers.” Did you not swear before that there will be no passing away for you
v.l: Wa 'Andhiri An-Nasa Yawma Ya'tihimu Al-`Adhabu Fayaqulu Al-Ladhina Zalamu Rabbana 'Akhkhirna 'Ila 'Ajalin Qaribin Nujib Da`wataka Wa Nattabi`i Ar-Rusula 'Awalam Takunu 'Aqsamtum Min Qablu Ma Lakum Min Zawalin

v.t: And you inhabited the homes of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We cited for you the examples
v.l: Wa Sakantum Fi Masakini Al-Ladhina Zalamu 'Anfusahum Wa Tabayyana Lakum Kayfa Fa`alna Bihim Wa Đarabna Lakumu Al-'Amthala

v.t: They planned their plans, but their plans are known to God, even if their plans can eliminate mountains
v.l: Wa Qad Makaru Makrahum Wa `Inda Allahi Makruhum Wa 'In Kana Makruhum Litazula Minhu Al-Jibalu

v.t: Do not ever think that God will break His promise to His messengers. God is Strong, Able to Avenge
v.l: Fala Tahsabanna Allaha Mukhlifa Wa`dihi Rusulahu 'Inna Allaha `Azizun Dhu Antiqamin

v.t: On the Day when the earth is changed into another earth, and the heavens, and they will emerge before God, the One, the Irresistible
v.l: Yawma Tubaddalu Al-'Arđu Ghayra Al-'Arđi Wa As-Samawatu Wa Barazu Lillahi Al-Wahidi Al-Qahhari

v.t: On that Day, you will see the sinners bound together in chains
v.l: Wa Tara Al-Mujrimina Yawma'idhin Muqarranina Fi Al-'Asfadi

v.t: Their garments made of tar, and the Fire covering their faces
v.l: Sarabiluhum Min Qatiranin Wa Taghsha Wujuhahumu An-Naru

v.t: That God may repay each soul according to what it has earned. God is Quick in reckoning
v.l: Liyajziya Allahu Kulla Nafsin Ma Kasabat 'Inna Allaha Sari`u Al-Hisabi

v.t: This is a proclamation for mankind, that they may be warned thereby, and know that He is One God, and that people of understanding may remember
v.l: Hadha Balaghun Lilnnasi Wa Liyundharu Bihi Wa Liya`lamu 'Annama Huwa 'Ilahun Wahidun Wa Liyadhakkara 'Ulu Al-'Albabi
